m0003.en: Collect your words, discover your gems.

m0005.zh: 无法读取应用版本，请重试。
m0005.en: Could not load the app version. Please retry.

m0009.zh: 基于 Leanote Android 重构，使用 Flutter 构建，支持本地 SQLite 离线缓存。
m0009.en: Rebuilt from Leanote Android with Flutter and a local SQLite cache for offline use.

m0013.zh: 请输入有效的邮箱地址

m0014.zh: 发送失败，请检查网络、当前账号密码及邮箱。若请求超时，请先检查收件箱，勿重复发送。
m0014.en: Could not send the email. Check your connection, current password and email address. If the request timed out, check your inbox before sending again.

m0015.zh: 修改失败，请检查网络、当前账号密码或用户名是否可用。若请求超时，请先刷新资料确认结果。
m0015.en: Could not update your profile. Check your connection, current password and username availability. If the request timed out, refresh your profile to check the result.

m0018.zh: 需要联网验证当前账号。密码仅用于本次操作，不会保存。
m0018.en: An internet connection is required to verify your account. Your password is used only for this operation and will not be saved.

m0019.zh: 发送验证邮件后，需在新邮箱中点击链接确认，邮箱才会变更。
m0019.en: After sending the verification email, follow the link in your new inbox to confirm the change.

m0020.zh: 当前登录账号（用户名或邮箱）

m0028.zh: 无法读取头像：{0}。文件需不超过 2 MiB、4096×4096，支持 PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/BMP。
m0028.en: Could not read the picture: {0}. Use a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or BMP file up to 2 MiB and 4096×4096 pixels.

m0029.zh: 密码已修改，但本机登录状态清理失败，请重试。不会再次修改密码。
m0029.en: Your password changed, but this device could not clear the login session. Please retry. Your password will not be changed again.

m0030.zh: 读取本地账号信息失败：{0}
m0030.en: Could not read local account information: {0}

m0031.zh: 资料已刷新，但头像刷新失败，保留原头像：{0}
m0031.en: Profile refreshed, but the picture could not be refreshed. Keeping the previous picture: {0}

m0032.zh: 刷新失败，仍显示本地资料：{0}
m0032.en: Could not refresh. Showing the local profile: {0}

m0036.zh: 密码已修改，本地笔记已保留。
m0036.en: Password changed. Your local notes have been kept.

m0044.zh: 验证邮件已发送，请在新邮箱确认后刷新资料。当前邮箱尚未修改。
m0044.en: Verification email sent. Confirm in your new inbox, then refresh your profile. Your current email has not changed yet.

m0047.zh: 账号信息保存在本地，离线时也可查看。点击右上角刷新可获取服务器上的最新资料。
m0047.en: Account information is stored locally for offline viewing. Use the refresh button to get the latest profile from your server.

m0048.en: Could not read accounts. Please retry.

m0049.zh: 切换失败，请重试；登录失效时请通过添加账号重新登录
m0049.en: Could not switch accounts. Please retry; if your login has expired, use Add account to sign in again.

m0051.zh: 切换保留各账号的离线修改和登录信息，不会自动同步。已退出的账号需要重新登录。
m0051.en: Switching keeps each account’s offline changes and login information without syncing automatically. Sign in again to access accounts you have signed out of.

m0055.zh: 读取本地附件失败，请重试
m0055.en: Could not read local attachments. Please retry.

m0058.zh: 将删除“{0}”的暂存原件及任务，不会删除服务端附件。未上传的文件将无法恢复，请先导出保留。
m0058.en: This deletes the staged original and task for “{0}”, without deleting the server attachment. Files that have not been uploaded cannot be recovered; export a copy first.

m0060.zh: 图片可能已经上传，但响应未收到。未关联正文的图片可能不出现在文件列表中；重新上传可能产生多余资源。确认接受后才允许重试，本地原件不会删除。
m0060.en: The image may have uploaded without a response. Images not linked to a note may be absent from the file list; uploading again may create an extra resource. Confirm to allow a retry. The local original will be kept.

m0061.zh: 先查看服务端文件列表，核实“{0}”没有上传成功。若原请求已成功，再次上传会产生重复附件。
m0061.en: Check the server file list first to make sure “{0}” was not uploaded. If the original request succeeded, another upload will create a duplicate attachment.

m0062.zh: 操作未完成：{0}。本地原件保留，请刷新核实状态。
m0062.en: Operation incomplete: {0}. The local original is kept. Refresh to check its status.

m0065.zh: 原件保存在本机，不会自动上传或随缓存清理。联网后逐项上传；需要当前密码，密码不保存。图片会追加到最新正文末尾并保存，再同步笔记以完成关联。
m0065.en: Originals are stored on this device, without automatic uploads or cache eviction. Upload each file when online using your current password, which will not be saved. Images are appended to the latest note body; sync the note to finish linking them.

m0076.zh: 请输入当前账号和密码
m0076.en: Enter your current account and password

m0077.zh: 上传未完成或结果未确认：{0}。请关闭窗口并刷新文件列表核实，不要重复上传。
m0077.en: Upload incomplete or unconfirmed: {0}. Close this window and refresh the file list to check. Do not upload again yet.

m0079.zh: 将先上传当前笔记的未同步正文，再上传附件；不会同步其他笔记。需要当前密码验证，密码不会保存。
m0079.en: This uploads the current note’s pending body changes before the attachment, without syncing other notes. Your current password is required for verification and will not be saved.

m0085.zh: 拖动图片调整位置，滑动缩放。动态图片使用第一帧。
m0085.en: Drag to position the image and use the slider to zoom. Animated images use the first frame.

m0088.zh: 请填写当前账号和密码
m0088.en: Enter your current account and password

m0089.zh: 上传失败，请检查网络、当前账号密码或服务端上传限制。超时后请先取消并刷新头像确认结果，不要重复上传。
m0089.en: Upload failed. Check your connection, current password and server upload limits. After a timeout, cancel and refresh your picture to check the result before uploading again.

m0090.zh: 图片已转换为小尺寸 PNG。需要当前密码验证身份；密码不会保存。
m0090.en: The picture has been converted to a small PNG. Your current password is required to verify your identity and will not be saved.

m0091.zh: 发现此账号的本地缓存
m0091.en: Local cache found for this account

m0092.zh:
不同步：保留本地笔记和未上传修改，登录后可手动同步。

重新同步：用服务端数据替换当前账号缓存，未上传修改将被丢弃，不会先上传。下载失败时保留原缓存。
m0092.en:
Keep local data: keep local notes and pending changes. You can sync manually after signing in.

Download again: replace this account’s cache with server data. Pending changes will be discarded without uploading first. If downloading fails, the original cache is kept.

m0096.zh: 图片尚未缓存或无法读取{0}
m0096.en: Image is not cached or cannot be read{0}

m0100.zh: 未能确认创建成功：{0}。若请求中断，请先同步核对标签列表。
m0100.en: Could not confirm creation: {0}. If the request was interrupted, sync first to check the tag list.

m0102.zh: 需要联网。创建的标签可以稍后添加到笔记，不会修改已有笔记。
m0102.en: An internet connection is required. You can add this tag to notes later; existing notes will not change.

m0108.zh: 用于当前账号在本机新建笔记，不改变已有笔记格式。新建时仍可临时选择另一种格式。
m0108.en: Applies to new notes for this account on this device. Existing note formats stay unchanged. You can still choose another format when creating a note.

m0110.zh: 请输入有效的 http:// 或 https:// 链接，不支持内嵌账号密码。
m0110.en: Enter a valid http:// or https:// link without an embedded username or password.

m0118.zh: 行数须为 1–20，列数须为 1–10 的整数。
m0118.en: Use whole numbers: 1–20 rows and 1–10 columns.

m0123.zh: 读取缓存用量失败，请重试
m0123.en: Could not read cache usage. Please retry.

m0124.en: Could not clear the cache. Please retry.

m0127.zh: 待处理资源下载：{0} 篇笔记

m0128.zh: 仅统计当前账号已下载的图片和附件。清理也会移除该账号的资源下载任务；笔记正文、待同步修改和文件列表会保留。清理后需联网重新下载。
m0128.en: Counts downloaded images and attachments for the current account only. Clearing also removes its resource download tasks. Note bodies, pending changes and file lists are kept. An internet connection is required to download resources again.

m0129.zh: 不包含导出或分享产生的副本。数据库空间可供后续复用，应用占用空间不一定立即缩小。
m0129.en: Does not include exported or shared copies. Database space can be reused later, so the app’s storage usage may not shrink immediately.

m0130.zh: 确认清理当前账号的离线图片和附件？
m0130.en: Clear this account’s offline images and attachments?

m0137.zh: 支持 UTF-8 Markdown、TXT、HTML（最多 32 MiB）及 .gemsnote 资源归档（最多 64 MiB）。普通文本文件不附带资源，不执行 HTML。资源归档中的原件存入待上传队列；确认后保存到当前笔记本。
m0137.en: Supports UTF-8 Markdown, TXT and HTML (up to 32 MiB), and .gemsnote resource archives (up to 64 MiB). Text files do not include resources; HTML is not executed. Archived originals enter the upload queue. Confirm to save in the current notebook.

m0151.zh: 无法连接服务器，请检查地址和网络。
m0151.en: Cannot connect to the server. Check the address and your connection.

m0152.zh: 该地址不是 Gemsnote API2 服务端。
m0152.en: This address is not a Gemsnote API2 server.

m0153.zh: 客户端版本过低，请先升级。
m0153.en: Please upgrade this client to continue.

m0154.zh: 服务端版本过低，请先升级。
m0154.en: Please upgrade the server to continue.

m0158.zh: 退出前上传未完成，是否不同步退出？本地数据将保留，下次登录同一服务器的同一用户后可继续同步。
m0158.en: Uploading before sign-out did not finish. Sign out without syncing? Local data will be kept. Sign in as the same user on the same server to continue syncing later.

m0166.zh: 选择新的父笔记本。此操作先保存到本机，下次同步时上传。
m0166.en: Choose a new parent notebook. The change is saved locally and uploaded at the next sync.

m0167.en: Could not load. Tap to retry.

m0171.zh: 正文已变化，请重新选择文字后插入链接。
m0171.en: The body has changed. Select the text again before inserting a link.

m0172.zh: 图片地址无效，未插入正文
m0172.en: Invalid image address. Nothing was inserted.

m0173.zh: 图片已插入并保存到本地，正文待同步。同步后可在阅读页下载预览图片。
m0173.en: Image inserted and saved locally, ready to sync. After syncing, download the image from the reader to preview it.

m0175.zh: 图片已暂存到本机。联网后从账号菜单的“本地待上传资源”上传并插入正文。
m0175.en: Image staged on this device. When online, use Local upload queue in the account menu to upload and insert it.

m0180.zh: 此笔记包含图片、不支持的链接或复杂 HTML，请继续编辑原文，避免丢失内容。
m0180.en: This note contains images, unsupported links or complex HTML. Continue editing the source to preserve its contents.

m0186.zh: 编辑 HTML 原文，预览显示基本排版及已缓存图片，不联网加载资源或执行脚本。原文将完整保存。
m0186.en: Edit HTML source. The preview shows basic formatting and cached images, without loading online resources or running scripts. The full source will be saved.

m0203.zh: 使用 Markdown 开始记录…

m0204.zh:
输入 HTML 原文，例如

开始记录…
m0204.en:
Enter HTML source, such as

Start writing…

m0207.zh: {0}：已处理 {1} 个，失败 {2} 个。缓存最多 64 MiB，较早文件可能被淘汰。
m0207.en: {0}: processed {1}, failed {2}. The cache holds up to 64 MiB; older files may be evicted.

m0208.en: Could not read the file list: {0}

m0210.zh: 附件已上传，但本地刷新失败，请同步后刷新文件列表，勿重复上传
m0210.en: Attachment uploaded, but the local refresh failed. Sync and refresh the file list; do not upload it again.

m0212.zh: 附件已保存到本机，可从待上传附件中处理
m0212.en: Attachment saved on this device. Open the upload queue to continue.

m0214.zh: 打开附件失败：未缓存、缓存已失效或系统无法打开，请联网下载后重试
m0214.en: Could not open attachment: it is not cached, the cache has expired, or no app can open it. Download it online and retry.

m0215.zh: 打开附件失败，请检查网络或系统文件打开功能后重试（最大 32 MiB）
m0215.en: Could not open attachment. Check your connection and available apps, then retry (maximum 32 MiB).

m0216.en: Could not locate the share sheet

m0217.zh: 分享附件失败：附件未缓存、缓存已失效或无法打开分享菜单，请联网下载后重试
m0217.en: Could not share attachment: it is not cached, the cache has expired, or the share sheet is unavailable. Download it online and retry.

m0218.zh: 分享附件失败，请检查网络、文件权限或系统分享功能后重试（最大 32 MiB）
m0218.en: Could not share attachment. Check your connection, file permissions and system sharing, then retry (maximum 32 MiB).

m0220.zh: 保存附件失败：附件未缓存、缓存已失效或无法写入保存位置，请联网下载后重试
m0220.en: Could not save attachment: it is not cached, the cache has expired, or the destination is not writable. Download it online and retry.

m0221.zh: 保存附件失败，请检查网络、文件权限或保存位置后重试（最大 32 MiB）
m0221.en: Could not save attachment. Check your connection, file permissions and destination, then retry (maximum 32 MiB).

m0227.zh: 仅查看缓存，可能不是最新内容；未缓存图片需联网查看。
m0227.en: View cached content only, which may be out of date. Uncached images require an internet connection.

m0228.zh: 图片最多 8 MiB，附件最多 32 MiB，缓存合计 64 MiB。已下载附件可离线保存，取消系统保存也保留缓存。联网刷新会清除本笔记旧文件缓存。
m0228.en: Images are limited to 8 MiB and attachments to 32 MiB, with a combined 64 MiB cache. Downloaded attachments can be saved offline; cancelling the save keeps the cache. Refreshing online clears this note’s previous file cache.

m0229.zh: 批量缓存会使用网络流量，最多并行下载 3 个文件；离开页面将停止安排后续下载。
m0229.en: Batch caching uses network data, with up to 3 simultaneous downloads. Leaving this page stops new downloads from being scheduled.

m0232.zh: 正在停止，等待已开始的下载结束…
m0232.en: Stopping. Waiting for active downloads to finish…

m0243.zh: 保存图片失败，请检查保存位置或可用空间后重试
m0243.en: Could not save image. Check the destination and available storage, then retry.

m0247.zh: 无法解码图片，请返回重试
m0247.en: Could not decode the image. Go back and retry.

m0249.zh: 将替换当前本地正文，包括尚未同步的正文修改。标题、标签、笔记本和星标保持不变。正文中的图片引用会保留，但不能找回服务端已删除的图片，也不恢复附件列表。恢复后需要同步到服务器。
m0249.en: This replaces the current local body, including unsynced body changes. The title, tags, notebook and star stay unchanged. Image references are kept, but deleted server images cannot be recovered, and the attachment list is not restored. Sync afterwards to update the server.

m0255.zh: 已查看的正文与已下载的历史图片可离线阅读。恢复保留图片引用，不恢复附件列表。
m0255.en: Previously viewed bodies and downloaded historical images can be read offline. Restoring keeps image references without restoring the attachment list.

m0261.zh: 上传未完成或结果未确认：{0}。正文未插入图片；图片资源可能已经上传，请勿直接重复提交。
m0261.en: Upload incomplete or unconfirmed: {0}. No image was inserted in the body. The image may already be uploaded; do not submit again yet.

m0263.zh: 将先上传当前笔记，再上传图片。插入后的正文保存到本地，下次同步后图片才会关联到服务端笔记。需要当前密码验证，密码不会保存。
m0263.en: This uploads the current note before the image. The updated body is saved locally; the next sync links the image to the server note. Your current password is required and will not be saved.

m0265.zh: 无法打开链接，请重试或复制地址到浏览器
m0265.en: Could not open the link. Retry or copy the address to a browser.

m0267.zh: 确认后交给浏览器或系统关联应用打开。
m0267.en: Confirm to open with your browser or the system’s associated app.

m0268.zh: 此地址仅支持查看和复制。
m0268.en: This address can only be viewed and copied.

m0272.zh: 系统分享失败，请重试；较大笔记请使用导出原文（分享最多 256 KiB）
m0272.en: System sharing failed. Please retry; export larger notes as source files (sharing limit: 256 KiB).

m0274.zh: 导出失败，请检查保存位置或可用空间后重试
m0274.en: Export failed. Check the destination and available storage, then retry.

m0296.zh: 笔记已删除或移入回收站，请重新搜索
m0296.en: The note was deleted or moved to trash. Please search again.

m0297.zh: 读取笔记失败，点击笔记可重试：{0}
m0297.en: Could not read the note. Tap it to retry: {0}

m0307.zh: 每次输入一个标签。保存到本地后，需要同步才会更新服务端。
m0307.en: Enter one tag at a time. Changes are saved locally; sync to update the server.

m0308.zh: 受当前接口限制，已有标签不能全部清空。
m0308.en: The current API does not support removing all existing tags.

m0311.zh: 读取已有标签失败，点击重试
m0311.en: Could not load existing tags. Tap to retry.

m0314.zh: 查询失败：{0}，本地数据已保留
m0314.en: Lookup failed: {0}. Local data is kept.

m0316.zh: 关联到这个服务端笔记本？

m0317.zh: 请先核实服务端没有创建成功。重复创建可能产生同名笔记本；此操作只恢复待同步状态，不会立即发送请求。
m0317.en: First verify that the server did not create the notebook. Repeating creation may produce duplicate names. This only marks it for a future sync; no request is sent now.

m0318.zh: 将“{0}”及其本地子笔记本、笔记关联到服务端笔记本 {1}，保留本地未同步内容。
m0318.en: Link “{0}”, its local subnotebooks and notes to server notebook {1}, keeping unsynced local content.

m0319.zh: 恢复失败：{0}，本地数据已保留
m0319.en: Recovery failed: {0}. Local data is kept.

m0321.zh: 已保存在本机，等待下次同步创建。可继续添加子笔记本和笔记。
m0321.en: Saved on this device, waiting to be created at the next sync. You can continue adding subnotebooks and notes.

m0322.zh: 创建请求结果未确认，本地数据已保留。不会自动重复创建；请联网查询名称、父级和排序相同的服务端笔记本。
m0322.en: The creation result is unconfirmed. Local data is kept and creation will not be repeated automatically. Go online to look for a server notebook with the same name, parent and order.

m0323.zh: 已完成服务端关联，请关闭并刷新。
m0323.en: Server notebook linked. Close and refresh.

m0325.zh: 没有匹配项。可能尚未创建成功，或已被其他客户端修改；请核实后再决定是否重试。
m0325.en: No matches. The notebook may not have been created, or another client may have changed it. Check before deciding whether to retry.

m0332.zh: 先保存到本机，下次同步时上传。
m0332.en: Saved locally first, then uploaded at the next sync.

m0338.zh: 两次输入的新密码不一致
m0338.en: The new passwords do not match

m0339.zh: 修改失败，请检查网络、当前密码和新密码要求。若请求超时，密码可能已修改，请取消并用新密码重新登录确认，勿自动重试。
m0339.en: Change failed. Check your connection, current password and new password requirements. If the request timed out, your password may have changed. Cancel and try signing in with the new password; do not retry automatically.

m0340.zh: 修改成功会使所有设备的登录状态失效，并返回登录页。本地笔记和未上传修改会保留；重新登录同一账号时请选择保留缓存，不要重新同步。
m0340.en: Changing your password signs out all devices and returns you to sign-in. Local notes and pending changes are kept. When signing in to this account again, keep the cache rather than downloading everything again.

m0345.zh: 请求已提交，请检查邮箱并按邮件说明重置密码。完成后返回登录页面。
m0345.en: Request submitted. Check your inbox and follow the instructions to reset your password, then return to sign-in.

m0346.zh: 请输入有效的服务器地址

m0348.zh: 需要服务器已配置邮件发送功能。如果无法收到邮件，请联系管理员重置密码。
m0348.en: Your server must have email delivery configured. If you cannot receive the email, ask your administrator to reset your password.

m0351.zh:
将用服务端数据替换当前账号的本地笔记、笔记本和标签，未上传的修改将被丢弃，不会先上传。其他账号的数据不受影响。

下载失败时保留原缓存；下载成功后替换不可撤销。
m0351.en:
Server data will replace this account’s local notes, notebooks and tags. Pending changes will be discarded without uploading first. Other accounts are unaffected.

The original cache is kept if downloading fails. Once downloading succeeds, replacement cannot be undone.

m0354.zh: 查看地址后选择复制或外部打开
m0354.en: Inspect an address, then copy it or open it externally

m0355.zh: 最多列出 100 个不同地址，其余可查看原文。
m0355.en: Shows up to 100 distinct addresses. View the source for the rest.

m0356.zh: 文件尚未缓存，请联网下载
m0356.en: File is not cached. Connect to the internet to download it.

m0357.zh: 文件已缓存，可离线使用

m0362.zh: 离线使用已下载的文件；无法离线确认共享权限是否撤销。
m0362.en: Use downloaded files offline. Shared permissions cannot be checked while offline.

m0363.zh: 操作时核实共享权限和文件版本；图片最多 8 MiB，附件最多 32 MiB。
m0363.en: Permissions and file versions are checked when you use a file. Images: up to 8 MiB. Attachments: up to 32 MiB.

m0374.zh: 图片不属于共享资源快照
m0374.en: Image is not in the shared resource snapshot

m0378.zh: 缓存可能已过期；离线时无法确认共享权限是否已撤销。
m0378.en: The cache may be outdated. Shared permissions cannot be checked while offline.

m0379.zh: 只读浏览；已查看的正文和已下载的图片附件可离线使用。文件操作会核实在线共享权限和版本。
m0379.en: Read-only browsing. Viewed bodies and downloaded images and attachments work offline. File operations verify permissions and versions when online.

m0383.zh: 笔记已保存，清理待处理分享失败：{0}。重试不会重复创建笔记。
m0383.en: Note saved, but the pending share could not be cleared: {0}. Retrying will not create a duplicate note.

m0385.zh: 将移除待处理内容，不创建笔记。
m0385.en: Removes the pending content without creating a note.

m0393.en: The file will be staged on this device. Upload it from the account menu when online. Importing does not upload files automatically.

m0395.zh: 取消勾选可作为普通附件保留原始文件
m0395.en: Uncheck to keep the original file as a regular attachment

m0396.zh: 此分享已指定其他账号，请切换账号后继续，或忽略这条分享。
m0396.en: This share is assigned to another account. Switch accounts to continue, or dismiss it.

m0398.zh: 请先创建笔记本，再回来导入；稍后处理会保留分享。
m0398.en: Create a notebook first, then return to import. Choosing Later keeps the pending share.

m0467.en: This note was removed or is not in the current account.

m0468.zh: 请先在应用中新建笔记本

m0485.en: Picture refresh failed (note sync is unaffected): {0}

m0490.en: Historical body restored locally, ready to sync

m0496.zh: 笔记已复制到本地，待同步
m0496.en: Note copied locally, ready to sync

m0515.zh: 正在读取资源缓存设置…

m0516.zh: 读取资源缓存设置失败，点击重试
m0516.en: Could not load resource cache settings. Tap to retry.

m0530.zh: 立即同步（{0} 篇待上传）

m0531.zh: 立即同步（{0} 篇笔记、{1} 个笔记本待上传）
m0531.en: Sync now ({0} notes and {1} notebooks pending)

m0537.zh: 选择笔记或开始全新记录。
m0537.en: Choose a note or start writing.

m0539.en: Long-press the Android home screen and add Gemsnote Recent Notes. Titles are hidden by default. Enabling this shows the current account’s 30 most recent note titles, without bodies. The widget refreshes after edits, syncing and returning to the app.

m0540.en: Show note titles on home screen

languageLoadFailed.zh: 读取语言设置失败，暂时跟随系统。
languageLoadFailed.en: Could not load the language setting. Using the system language.

m0546.en: Applies to all accounts on this device, without changing note content.

largeTable.en: [Complex or large table shown as text. View the source for details.]

tableCursorOutside.en: Move the cursor outside the table first to avoid nesting tables.

tableChanged.zh: 表格已变化，请重新选择单元格后重试
tableChanged.en: The table has changed. Select a cell again and retry.

uploadInvalidState.en: Unexpected status; export the original to keep it

m0565.zh: 文件尚未缓存或缓存已失效，请联网下载

m0566.zh: 文件列表已变化，请刷新后重试

m0567.zh: 共享列表已变化，请刷新后重试

m0568.zh: 此共享正文尚未缓存或已失效，请联网刷新后查看
m0568.en: This shared body is not cached or has expired. Refresh online to view it.

m0569.en: Verify the notebook creation result before changing its name or location.

m0570.zh: 目标笔记本无效，不能移到自身、子级或循环层级下

m0571.en: The note changed or is unavailable. Reopen it before copying.

m0572.zh: 目标笔记本不存在，请刷新后重试
m0572.en: The destination notebook does not exist. Refresh and retry.

m0573.en: Copying notes with links, images, attachments or complex HTML is not yet supported.

m0577.zh: 本地附件暂存已满（最多 64 个、合计 64 MiB），请先处理或导出已有附件
m0577.en: Local attachment staging is full (64 files, 64 MiB total). Process or export existing attachments first.

m0579.zh: 附件任务状态已变化，请刷新
m0579.en: The attachment task changed. Refresh to continue.

m0581.zh: 图片上传结果尚未确认
m0581.en: Image upload result is not confirmed

m0582.en: The original note is missing or in trash. The original image is kept.

m0583.en: The cached historical body changed. Reopen the history version.

m0584.zh: 图片缓存已清理或历史列表已更新，请重试
m0584.en: The image cache was cleared or the history list was updated. Please retry.

m0585.en: The parent notebook no longer exists.

m0586.en: Notebook creation is unconfirmed. Use its menu to check and recover; creation will not repeat automatically.

m0588.zh: 笔记本任务状态已变化，请刷新
m0588.en: The notebook task changed. Refresh to continue.

m0589.zh: 笔记本创建结果与本地内容不一致，请核实恢复
m0589.en: The notebook creation result differs from local content. Verify it before recovery.

m0590.zh: 目标笔记本已有未同步修改或更新版本，请先处理
m0590.en: The destination notebook has pending changes or a newer version. Resolve those first.

m0591.zh: 共享资源缓存已失效，请刷新列表

m0595.zh: 不支持下载此图片地址
m0595.en: Downloading from this image address is not supported.

m0596.zh: 图片不属于当前笔记，请同步后重试
m0596.en: The image does not belong to this note. Sync and retry.

m0597.en: Sync this note before uploading an image.

m0598.zh: 请先同步此笔记，再上传附件

m0602.zh: 图片不属于此历史版本
m0602.en: The image does not belong to this history version.

m0603.en: Enter your account, current password and new username.

m0604.en: Enter your current account, password and a valid new email.

m0605.zh: 请填写当前账号、当前密码及新密码
m0605.en: Enter your current account, current password and new password.

m0606.zh: 该笔记本没有待核实的创建请求
m0606.en: This notebook has no creation request awaiting verification.

m0608.en: Tag names must be 1–200 characters without line breaks or control characters.

m0609.en: This share is assigned to another account.

m0616.en: Taking pictures is not supported on this platform yet.

m0619.en: Choose a valid PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or BMP image.

m0630.en: The converted PNG cannot exceed 8 MiB.

m0632.en: Only Markdown, TXT and HTML files are supported.

m0634.en: Binary content is not supported. Choose UTF-8 text.

m0635.en: This address cannot be opened externally.

m0637.en: Shared text exceeds 256 KiB. Export the source instead.

m0638.en: Shared text is invalid or exceeds 256 KiB.

m0642.en: Shared resource is incomplete. Share it again.

m0643.zh: 不能向已删除或回收站笔记上传附件

m0646.en: The created note differs from the original request. Local changes are preserved. Choose Review note creation in the note menu.

m0650.en: The table snapshot contains extra content.

m0652.en: The cell position is no longer valid. Select it again.

nativeStorageError13.zh: 分享文件不完整，请重新分享
nativeStorageError13.en: Shared file is incomplete. Share it again

notebookReviewIntro.zh: 先读取远端名称和位置，再决定保留哪一方。打开此窗口不会联网或修改数据。
notebookReviewIntro.en: Read the remote name and location before choosing which to keep. Opening this dialog does not connect or change data.

notebookKeepConfirm.zh: 将本地名称和位置保留为待同步修改，基于刚核对的远端版本重试。下一次同步才上传，若远端再次变化会重新报告冲突。笔记正文与子级不变。
notebookKeepConfirm.en: Keep the local name and location pending against the reviewed remote version. The next sync will upload them; further remote changes will cause another conflict. Note content and children are preserved.

notebookRemoteConfirm.zh: 放弃这个笔记本待同步的名称和位置，采用已核对的远端值，并刷新所需且没有本地修改的父级。笔记正文和其它待同步修改保留。
notebookRemoteConfirm.en: Discard this notebook’s pending name and location, use the reviewed remote values, and refresh required parents that have no local edits. Note content and other pending changes are preserved.

notebookConflictAccount.zh: 账号已变化，请关闭后重新打开。
notebookConflictAccount.en: Account changed. Close and reopen this dialog.

notebookConflictLocalChanged.zh: 本地笔记本已变化或没有待处理修改，请关闭后重新核对。
notebookConflictLocalChanged.en: The local notebook changed or has no pending changes. Close and review again.

notebookConflictRemoteUnavailable.zh: 远端笔记本已删除、不可用或版本回退。本地修改已保留；暂不能采用该远端状态，请先在服务端核实。
notebookConflictRemoteUnavailable.en: The remote notebook was deleted, is unavailable, or its version went backwards. Local changes are preserved. Verify it on the server before resolving.

notebookConflictInvalidSnapshot.zh: 远端笔记本数据无效，未修改本地数据。
notebookConflictInvalidSnapshot.en: Remote notebook data is invalid. Local data was not changed.

notebookConflictRemoteChanged.zh: 远端笔记本或父级再次变化，请重新读取并核对。
notebookConflictRemoteChanged.en: The remote notebook or its parents changed again. Read and review them again.

notebookConflictHierarchy.zh: 所选位置缺失或会形成循环。未修改数据，请先核对父级的待同步修改。
notebookConflictHierarchy.en: The selected location is missing or would create a cycle. No data changed. Review pending parent changes first.

noteCreationIntro.zh: 适用于创建请求结果与本地内容不一致的笔记。联网读取远端版本并核对正文和属性；读取不会修改任何一端。
noteCreationIntro.en: For notes whose creation result differs from local content. Fetch the remote version to review its source and properties. Fetching changes neither version.

noteCreationConfirm.zh: 确认以本地正文和属性为准？下一次同步将使用已核对的远端版本更新同一篇笔记，覆盖远端正文和属性，并保留远端附件及本地待上传资源。现在只记录恢复选择，不立即上传。
noteCreationConfirm.en: Use the local source and properties? The next sync will update the same note using the reviewed remote version, replacing its source and properties while retaining remote attachments and pending local resources. This records your choice without uploading now.

noteCreationAccount.zh: 账号已变化，请关闭后重新核对。
noteCreationAccount.en: Account changed. Close and review again.

noteCreationLocalChanged.zh: 本地笔记已变化或不再需要创建恢复，请重新核对。
noteCreationLocalChanged.en: The local note changed or no longer needs creation recovery. Review again.

noteCreationRemoteChanged.zh: 远端笔记已变化，请重新读取并核对。
noteCreationRemoteChanged.en: The remote note changed. Fetch and review again.

noteCreationUnavailable.zh: 远端笔记不可用、已删除或在回收站中。本地内容已保留。
noteCreationUnavailable.en: The remote note is unavailable, deleted, or in trash. Local content is preserved.

noteCreationTags.zh: 服务端暂不支持清空全部标签。本地内容已保留，请先核对并调整两端标签后重试。
noteCreationTags.en: The server cannot clear all tags. Local content is preserved. Review and adjust the tags before retrying.

noteCreationFailed.zh: 核对未完成，本地内容已保留：{0}
noteCreationFailed.en: Review failed. Local content is preserved: {0}

bundleImportInfo.zh: 包含 {0} 个资源原件，将存入待上传队列。外部链接保持原文，不下载外部网站。
bundleImportInfo.en: Includes {0} resource originals, saved to the upload queue. External links remain unchanged; external websites are not downloaded.

noteBundleTooLarge.zh: 资源归档超过限制：原文 8 MiB，资源共 32 MiB、最多 64 项。
noteBundleTooLarge.en: Bundle exceeds limits: 8 MiB source, 32 MiB resources, up to 64 resources.

noteBundleChanged.zh: 笔记或资源已变化，请重新打开后重试。
noteBundleChanged.en: The note or resources changed. Reopen and retry.

noteBundleMissingResource.zh: 缺少正文中的图片原件，请先下载图片后重试。
noteBundleMissingResource.en: An original body image is missing. Download the image and retry.

invalidNoteBundle.zh: 笔记归档格式或版本无效。
invalidNoteBundle.en: Invalid note archive format or version.

invalidBundleResource.zh: 归档中的资源编号无效。

invalidBundleOrigin.zh: 归档中的资源来源无效。

bundleChecksumMismatch.zh: 资源校验失败，归档可能已损坏。
bundleChecksumMismatch.en: Resource checksum failed; the archive may be damaged.

bundleSupportedFiles.zh: 仅支持 Markdown、TXT、HTML 或 .gemsnote 资源归档
bundleSupportedFiles.en: Only Markdown, TXT, HTML or .gemsnote resource archives are supported

bundleFileLimit.zh: 文件超过允许大小：{0} 字节
bundleFileLimit.en: File exceeds the allowed size: {0} bytes
